# Use-case portfolio (long list, scores and ranking)

*Generated by `python -m evals.run rebuild` on 2026-10-08. Client: Falcon Bay Services LLC (fictional). Evidence numbers come from the event log (BPI Challenge 2020, CC BY-NC 4.0) and the synthetic staff interviews and survey.*

Weights: value 30%, feasibility 20%, data readiness 20%, risk 15%, time to value 15%. Scores are 1-5; for risk and time to value, 5 is the good end (low risk, fast).

Analyst scores are a **draft written by the coding agent for Sara to review**; the LLM columns are independent model scores (one use case per call, same anchors).

| Rank | ID | Use case | V | F | D | R | T | Weighted | main rank | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | UC01 | **Receipt and policy pre-check before submission** (LLM reading receipts + rules for arithmetic) | 5 | 4 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 4.10 | 1 | 12.4% of cases (1,301) have at least one rejection; administration rejects first in 64.0% of them; rejected cases take 11.2 days at the median vs 7.3 without a rejection. Staff themes: rejections and rework 0%, receipts 0% of snippets. |
| 2 | UC02 | **Approver assistant: reminders plus a one-line claim summary** (LLM summary + rules-based reminders) | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4.00 | 2 | The supervisor's final approval waits 0.9 days at the median and 5.9 at p90; supervisors are on 96.6% of cases and hold 17.4% of all waiting time. Staff theme: approval delays 0%. |
| 3 | UC05 | **Weekly bottleneck report with an AI-written summary** (Process mining + LLM summary) | 2 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 4 | 3.95 | 5 | 99 different process paths; the payment stage holds 56.4% of all waiting time. Today the numbers are built by hand (staff theme: manual work 0%). |
| 4 | UC03 | **Arabic/English travel-policy Q&A assistant** (Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)) | 3 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 3.70 | 3 | Staff theme: policy unclear 100% of snippets; survey 'I understand what the policy allows' averages 2.6/5. |
| 5 | UC14 | **Draft-claim completion nudges** (Rules + LLM-written message) | 1 | 5 | 4 | 5 | 5 | 3.60 | 14 | 134 claims were saved but never submitted in two years. |
| 6 | UC09 | **Rejection-reason drafting assistant** (LLM drafting, clerk edits and sends) | 3 | 4 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 3.50 | 9 | After a rejection, employees take 1.0 days (median) and 5.7 (p90) to respond; 9.7% of cases are resubmitted. Staff theme: rework 0%. |
| 7 | UC07 | **Receipt OCR and auto-fill of claim lines** (Document AI (OCR + extraction)) | 4 | 3 | 3 | 4 | 3 | 3.45 | 7 | Staff theme: manual entry and duplicate work 0%; every line is typed by hand today. |
